candidates.title: Rajnath Singh pitches joint defence production with ASEAN countries
candidates.excerpt: Defence minister Rajnath Singh highlighted the pressing necessity for enhanced defence collaboration between India and ASEAN nations. He advocated for the joint production of military technologies and improvements in counter-drone capabilities, cyber defence, and maritime monitoring. Singh emphasized the significance of cost-effective defence innovations in contemporary warfare, referencing recent drone conflicts.
